fields.source_first_note: Read the whole Amr ibn Harith source, including the final-reporter kinship/biography and full estate inventory. The actual finite report is that after death no dirham/dinar/slave/bondwoman or other property remained except white mule, weapons and the land already dedicated. Keep all negatives, exceptions and prior charitable disposition. The multistep chain and attached Juwairiyah/brother/umm-al-muminin identification are introductory biographical context rather than a second historical event; preserve Amr’s actual reporter name and reporting frame. No external beneficiary, asset or canonical familial identity is added.

Entire own field read. Preserve Amr ibn Harith’s finite death/remaining-property report, each negated category, the three exceptions and the source-dedicated-land clause. The preceding route and attached static narrator-identity/kinship explanation can remain context; they do not independently constitute another report. Keep literal narrator/name spellings without canonical identity repair or additional assets.

Read the whole Aswad account of people’s Ali-wasi claim at Aisha, her challenge and personal death-scene account. The Prophet-related wasi parenthesis supplies whose executor is claimed and should remain. Retain both chest/lap alternatives and the explicit unresolved or-she-said qualification; the parenthetic instead-of-chest formula merely explains the already printed alternative and can be context. Preserve the request for the water basin and the head-as-subject parenthesis, since they supply the requested object and falling subject. Aisha’s lack of awareness of death and repeated challenge remain her own source assertion, not a separately proven theological conclusion. Keep narrator/transmitter alternative distinct from direct Prophet speech; initial pure chain is context.

Own complete reading preserves the reported claim and Aisha’s actual question/denial, both chest-versus-lap source alternatives, basin request and the head falling before she realized death. Keep ( نبی کریم صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم کے ) as the executor relation, ( پانی کا ) as object description and ( سر مبارک ) as the actual subject. The small ( بجائے سینے کے ) explanatory formula can remain context while the full alternative and uncertainty stay visible under qualified transmission. No chosen location, external executor identity or implied completed appointment is asserted.

Read every clause of Saad’s visit/will dialogue and final family circumstance. Retain the Hajj-al-Wada occasion, Mecca location and stated dislike of death after migration. The parenthetic Saad-ibn-Khawla identification of the separately named Ibn Afra is an appositional gloss; keep it in context rather than certify the identity. All/half/third questions and two negatives, the heirs-rich comparison, Allah-directed spending predicate, wife-morsel charity predicate, present no-need-for-will qualification and benefit/opponents-loss limits are actual source-rendered assertions/qualifiers and must remain bounded as printed; no independent verbatim certification is claimed. The final third-person only-one-daughter statement is actual supplied family circumstance, to keep separately qualified rather than turn into Prophet speech. Hindi’s initial Abu Numan spelling is not replaced from Urdu.

All Urdu words read independently, from route through the final one-daughter clause. The visit’s Hajj-al-Wada timing and place remain. The Saad-ibn-Khawla parenthesis is unverified alternate-name exposition of Ibn Afra and can be context. Retain every substantive will fraction, refusal, heirs comparison, for-Allah spending condition, even-morsel charity predication, current no-need qualification and explicitly restricted opponents’ harm. These parenthetical source predicates are not merely dictionary definitions; preserve them without certifying reconstructed direct speech. The final supplied family circumstance has an unassigned narrative voice and should not be recast as the Messenger’s words. Source Abu Nuaym spelling remains its own.

Read the full visibly abbreviated Hindi. Its route ends after Hashim ibn Hashim and does not supply Urdu’s named Saad/father link, so the first-person patient must remain qualified as an unidentified voice in this local shortened transmission, not invented as Hashim or borrowed Saad. Actual illness/visit, request, possible recovery/benefit and half/third dialogue are finite. The explicit yani death-in-Mecca paraphrase is explanatory context. Retain the parenthetic offspring domain because no-one-else would otherwise overstate all relationships. Preserve both much/large alternative words with OR, while the merely said-that comparison formula and amount noun gloss may be context. Final people’s one-third practice and stated permission are supplied historical/result clauses under qualified report voice, not an independently asserted legal ruling or direct Prophet quote.

Own full Urdu does explicitly name Amir’s father Saad ibn Abi Waqqas as the first-person patient; preserve that own attribution without using it to fill Hindi. Keep the illness/visit dialogue, recovery/benefit possibility, single-daughter/offspring scope, both will fractions and the printed much-or-large wording. The yani Mecca-death interpretation and small said-that/amount comparison glosses are context; do not erase the actual alternative or child restriction. Separate the final people’s adoption of one-third wills and supplied permission consequence from direct quoted Prophet speech, retaining only the source’s claim and unknown scope, not issuing a legal opinion.
